newsitem.title: CONGO: Six die in Congo after eating peanut butter sauce.
newsitem.headline: Six die in Congo after eating peanut butter sauce.

text.p: Six people died of food poisoning in the Central African state of Congo after eating a local dish prepared with a peanut butter sauce, medical officials said on Monday.
The six died after a weekend meal and five other people were being treated in hospital in the capital Brazzaville, they said.

Peanut butter, a delicacy used widely in fish and meat sauces in Congo, is sold in Brazzaville's markets. Some residents no longer buy it, accusing the market women of adding suspect ingredients to increase its weight and their profits.
